svg.title: Three training schedules with the same pretraining data and 3,000 RL updates

cc:Work.dc:title: Three training schedules with the same pretraining data and 3,000 RL updates
cc:Work.dc:description: Four schedules on one axis. Standard, one PT run: all pretraining, then 3,000 RL updates. Standard, two PT runs: first half of pretraining, second half, then 3,000 RL updates. Inter-RL: first half, 1,500 RL updates, second half starting from the RL checkpoint, 1,500 RL updates. Inter-RL + replay: the same, with the correct responses from the inter-RL stage mixed uniformly into the second half, which makes that stage longer.
